name: spot-case-fix-dev
description: Sets currency_spot_mapping_table.spot and product_master_table.curr_mult_factor to the exact spelling used in underlying_settle_value_table (latest price date). MySQL matched text without case, PostgreSQL does not, so recon, statement and cash found no FX rate. Run with the session option search_path=opera,public (the product master clone trigger names its table without a schema). Counts are not fixed: the preview prints them.

steps.where: tenant_id = '227cd5f5-4498-4dba-bda9-05b8edc41113' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM opera.underlying_settle_value_table u WHERE u.tenant_id = '227cd5f5-4498-4dba-bda9-05b8edc41113' AND u.value_date = (SELECT max(value_date) FROM opera.underlying_settle_value_table WHERE tenant_id = '227cd5f5-4498-4dba-bda9-05b8edc41113') AND lower(u.underlying_id) = lower(currency_spot_mapping_table.spot) AND u.underlying_id <> currency_spot_mapping_table.spot)

set.spot: (SELECT min(u.underlying_id) FROM opera.underlying_settle_value_table u WHERE u.tenant_id = '227cd5f5-4498-4dba-bda9-05b8edc41113' AND u.value_date = (SELECT max(value_date) FROM opera.underlying_settle_value_table WHERE tenant_id = '227cd5f5-4498-4dba-bda9-05b8edc41113') AND lower(u.underlying_id) = lower(currency_spot_mapping_table.spot))

preconditions.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT lower(underlying_id) FROM opera.underlying_settle_value_table WHERE tenant_id = '227cd5f5-4498-4dba-bda9-05b8edc41113' AND value_date = (SELECT max(value_date) FROM opera.underlying_settle_value_table WHERE tenant_id = '227cd5f5-4498-4dba-bda9-05b8edc41113') GROUP BY lower(underlying_id) HAVING count(DISTINCT underlying_id) > 1) x
preconditions.reason: the price table has one spelling per spot id, so the target spelling is unambiguous

steps.where: curr_mult_factor IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM opera.underlying_settle_value_table u WHERE u.tenant_id = '227cd5f5-4498-4dba-bda9-05b8edc41113' AND u.value_date = (SELECT max(value_date) FROM opera.underlying_settle_value_table WHERE tenant_id = '227cd5f5-4498-4dba-bda9-05b8edc41113') AND lower(u.underlying_id) = lower(product_master_table.curr_mult_factor) AND u.underlying_id <> product_master_table.curr_mult_factor)

set.curr_mult_factor: (SELECT min(u.underlying_id) FROM opera.underlying_settle_value_table u WHERE u.tenant_id = '227cd5f5-4498-4dba-bda9-05b8edc41113' AND u.value_date = (SELECT max(value_date) FROM opera.underlying_settle_value_table WHERE tenant_id = '227cd5f5-4498-4dba-bda9-05b8edc41113') AND lower(u.underlying_id) = lower(product_master_table.curr_mult_factor))
